basics.label: Hotel Receptionist
basics.summary:
After 15+ years in software engineering, I'm making a deliberate move toward hospitality.

I'm an extrovert who genuinely enjoys people and thrives in face-to-face interactions — something remote work doesn't offer.

I'm mature, calm under pressure, reliable by nature, and a fast learner in any new environment.

I speak fluent English and Italian, and I bring a background in communication and problem-solving that translates well to a guest-facing role.
